server: LabServer63 (main); evidence root ~/rest_orbit80; read-only: earlier roots incl. ~/rest_sym79

basis.restarts: r0 = the frozen G2 basis (WL75 selection, stored float64); r1, r2 = N(0, 1) logits from seeds 8001 / 8002 (the WL74 restart pattern)
basis.population: basis80.prepare: S16-R fitting-replica-0-3 means; rest: every exact D4h image (sym79 maps), deduplicated per source by image port; pt0: originals only
basis.weighting: J = 0.5 rest + 0.5 pt0; rest = mean over 16 sources of the mean over each source's distinct images; pt0 = mean over 16 sources
basis.selection: lowest final fitting J (fitting replicas only); mixtures re-indexed onto G2 by the optimal joint-pattern assignment (exact operator symmetry)
basis.pre_freeze_development: dev root: targets prepared (256 = 240 rest images + 16 pt0; 48 image ports shared by the orbit-related S16-R pairs (0,3), (1,7), (10,13), kept per source); sufficient-statistics identity 3.3e-16; FISTA 8.9 ms per target-iteration (float64, chunk 16, 4.66 GB); estimate 2.5 h per restart. No fit was run.
basis.lanes: r0 and r1 concurrently, then r2 (one GPU)

question: Is the WL79 failure primarily a consequence of orientation-biased fitting of the frozen G2 angular basis, and can correcting that bias improve genuine source transfer within the existing rank-16 W+UV-Q architecture?

stage0.checks: C1 WL79 records (sha256, contract VALID, Stage 1 ANGULAR BASIS LIMIT, no WL79 Stage 5 references / frozen ports file); C2 group composition 16 x 16 (ports, incoming, outgoing bins); C3 feature-construction non-equivariance of W+UV-Q inputs classified TIE / OTHER (probe ties, 128-NN ties) - documentation only; C4 symmetry classes A / B / C (only A authorises label permutation; dented poses identity only)
stage0.valid: C1 contract VALID and C2 without failure; the bin-frame convention is not modified

stage2.G0: the WL79 Stage 1 oracle record of the frozen G2 basis (reused; same code, data and basis)
stage2.G1: the selected orbit-balanced basis, full WL79 oracle (7 variants x 16 sources, 3,000 + 3,000 iterations); non-selected restarts: id, r90, r180 (descriptive)

gate.rule: (a) WL79 rule on G1: transformed / G1 original <= 1.25 and no WL59 gate passed by the G1 original failed by a transformed oracle; (b) original-orientation preservation: G1 original <= 1.25 x G0 original, and no WL59 gate passed by the G0 original failed by the G1 original; (c) orbit level: G1 transformed <= 1.25 x G0 original; every operation, group and metric; G1 oracle convergence change <= 1e-3; Stage 0 valid
gate.pass: RANK-16 ORBIT REPRESENTABILITY SUPPORTED (and ORIENTATION-BIASED BASIS SUPPORTED, since G0 failed the same WL79 rule) -> Stage 3
gate.fail: stop before learned training; attribution reported (restart spread / convergence = optimisation; residual gap with converged restarts = capacity or global factorisation, as far as evidence supports)

stage3.frozen_before: any Stage 1 basis result and any candidate metric (committed while the Stage 1 restarts run)
stage3.design: 2 x 2: A0 = historical G2 / A1 = selected orbit-balanced G1 (G2-aligned); B0 = historical presentation / B1 = exact rest-symmetry presentation (fit79.SymRest, the WL79 Latin schedule; pt0 identity). A0B0 = the frozen Q78 control (never retrained). Three new arms x two matched spatial seeds
stage3.initialisation: q78.init_model (P_590x trunk, rank rows r mod 8, encoder / pair_layer reinit seeds 7801 / 7802), then in/out logits := the arm basis (float64 stored, float32 at load). Trunk bitwise the Q78 initial trunk (test T2). G1 latent identity fixed by the Stage 1 assignment onto G2
stage3.unchanged: q78.TransportQ (rank 16, WL78 inputs, capacity), J (mean rest / pt0 ato74.objective_m) + 1.0 L_sym (WL72), S16-R fitting replicas 0-3, Adam, cosine 3e-3 -> 3e-5, 20,000 steps, clip 1.0, checkpoints 2k / 6k / 10k, final iterate primary (no selection)
stage3.confounds: B1 changes the effective training distribution (192-port orbit, each orientation 1/16; WL79 stage2.confound). A1 changes the frozen angular basis values only (same rank, softmax normalisation, constraints)
stage3.comparison: arms are controls within one hypothesis; no arm is selected on confirmation data; every arm is reported

execution.chain: run80.sh: wait for chain A; [Stage 2 passed] dev smoke on ~/rest_orbit80_dev (40-step fits, 10-step probe, 2 reference slots at 1M photons, forced gates; no metric used); evidence chain80.py: [Stage 2 gate] tests -> probe -> six fits -> supervised eval + fit gate -> mechanism -> [>= 1 arm passes both] Stage 5 -> Stage 6 -> cost -> export
execution.lanes_rule: probe the two heaviest runs concurrently with the real configuration; two lanes iff both complete and the sum of peak reserved memory <= 0.85 x GPU memory, else one lane
execution.precision: float32 model and training (TF32 off), float64 basis fits / oracles / estimators

fit_gate.rule: per run: hi <= 1.25 x max over the Q78 seeds for every group / metric; validity: every passivity check passed and A/O bitwise the arm basis; an arm passes iff both seeds pass

mechanism.primary: exact-symmetry response consistency on out-of-orbit development sources (WL74 Stage 4 rest ports + WL77A Part 0 rest non-footprint ports; scored earlier): for every non-identity rest operation g, near-field (0-5 mm around the image) relative discrepancy between the prediction at g(p) and the exact image (sym79) of the prediction at p, worst channel; mean over (source, operation); native AND fine16 contrast
mechanism.rule: an arm passes iff each seed has native and contrast discrepancy <= 0.5 x the same-seed Q78 value
mechanism.descriptive: the same on the 16 training sources (in-orbit), coarse-contrast consistency (total), orientation-specific physical error on the exact images of held-out training replicas (WL79 operations), class-B historical pairs (approximate; never a gate), WL77A Part 0 groups and DEF (development)

stage4.stop: if no arm passes both the fit gate and the mechanism gate: stop before Stage 5 (no references generated); Stage 6 descriptive

stage5.population: the WL79 frozen, never-referenced population (sym79_v1 stage5; 19 rest ports); re-derived and checked by ports80.py (identical list, no WL79 references / ports file / Stage 5 output, disjoint from the training orbit and earlier scored ports + images, one port per orbit)
stage5.references: probes80.py: probes74 code unchanged, rest, K = 4, the WL79 predeclared seeds 79000000 + slot*1e4 + bin*100 + rep; eval73 precision qualification
stage5.scored: every arm that passed the fit gate, provided >= 1 arm passed both gates; controls Q78, A75, AR
stage5.groups: BND_FAR (TBE / SM / SR far, 6), BND_NEAR (7), INT (4), UNS (SV near, 2; per matrix), BND_HI / BND_LO, TOPBOT, SIDE; per-source distance to the training orbit

decision.stronger: per group, Q78 or A75 by the lower two-seed mean of con_coarse hi
decision.per_arm: far YES iff max over the arm seeds of BND_FAR con_coarse hi <= 0.8 x min over the stronger control seeds AND < min of their lower 95 % bounds; NO iff min > 0.8 x max; else OVERLAP; regression YES iff min arm >= 1.25 x max of the better control (BND_FAR / BND_NEAR: abs_native, abs_fine16, abs_coarse; INT: + con_coarse); benefit = valid and far YES and no regression YES
decision.factorial: BASIS CHANGE BENEFIT iff benefit(A1B0); SYMMETRY PRESENTATION BENEFIT iff benefit(A0B1); INTERACTION BENEFIT iff benefit(A1B1) and (no single-factor arm has a benefit, or max A1B1 BND_FAR con_coarse <= 0.8 x min of each scored single-factor arm); INDEPENDENT SOURCE TRANSFER SUPPORTED iff any arm has a benefit; otherwise ORBIT-ONLY TRANSFER iff every scored arm is far NO (the scored arms passed the symmetry mechanism), NO TRANSFER BENEFIT iff every arm far NO without a mechanism pass, else INCONCLUSIVE. Main effects (mean over seeds, A0B0 = Q78) are descriptive. Stage 2 fail -> RANK-16 orbit representability not supported (stop); fit gate fail for every arm -> INSUFFICIENT FIT

stage6.deformation: DEF71 (cf2), CONFDEF72 (te2), DEF73 (te0) from the supervised evaluation and WL77A Part 0 DEF (te1) from the mechanism stage; no rest-only label is applied to deformed geometries
stage6.flag_rule: per arm and group: WORSE iff every arm seed has worst-channel error >= 1.25 x max Q78 or min-channel corr <= min Q78 - 0.03; RECOVERED iff every seed has error <= max Q78 / 1.25 and corr >= max Q78; else MAINTAINED/OVERLAP; DEFORMATION REGRESSION iff the primary group is WORSE
stage6.cost: cost80.py: Q78_5901 vs each arm's 5901 run (A75 reference) on the same GPU; angular pretraining and symmetry presentation costs
stage6.always: Stage 6 runs even when an earlier gate stops (descriptive; never changes an earlier verdict)

tests: test80.py T1-T7 (basis provenance / alignment symmetry, initialisation, physics, symmetry presentation, Stage 5 provenance, decision logic, no leakage)
